2026-2027.summary: National touring grosses for the week of October 4, 2026 showed volatility across Bushnell's slate: *Oh, Mary!* surged 800% to $1.87M—a new all-time high—while *Hell's Kitchen* declined 30% to $895K. *Operation Mincemeat* posted 44% growth to $1.12M, also marking a new peak. *Waitress* has not reported for 224 consecutive weeks; status requires confirmation with booking partners.
